sentences.text: Dredges work Florida’s inlets and channels all year, and they’re restricted vessels with one extra job: telling you which side is safe.
A vessel dredging or doing underwater work shows her red, white, red lights.
Then, on the side where the obstruction is, two all-round red lights in a vertical line, or two balls by day.
And on the side where you may pass, two all-round green lights in a vertical line, or two diamonds by day.
So which side do you take?
Green means go, just like a traffic light.

A boat engaged in diving operations that’s too small to show all of that shows the red, white, red lights, and a rigid replica of the International Code flag A, at least one meter high, visible all around.
In Florida you’ll also see the state’s red and white diver-down flag.
Either one means the same thing to you: slow down and stay well clear.
